site.name: The Shoulders of Giants Manifesto
site.description: The machines that will shape our century were built from all of us. They must belong to all of us.

home.aboutInitiator: It was initiated by {name}, AI automation expert and chair of {org}, in a personal capacity.
home.aboutProcess: The manifesto belongs to everyone who stands behind it. Feedback flows into new versions, and the changelog records what changed and why.

manifesto.title: Manifesto
manifesto.shapeText: Something missing or wrong? Help shape the next version.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Questions, press enquiries or ideas: write to {email}.
contact.feedback: Feedback on the text itself is welcome on {github}.

mail.validity: The link is valid for 48 hours.

signConfirm.subject: Confirm your signature
signConfirm.intro: Someone, hopefully you, asked to sign the Shoulders of Giants Manifesto with this email address. To confirm, open this link:
signConfirm.ignore: If this wasn't you, ignore this email; nothing will be published.

withdraw.subject: Withdraw your signature
withdraw.intro: Someone, hopefully you, asked to withdraw a signature of the Shoulders of Giants Manifesto made with this email address. To continue, open this link:
withdraw.ignore: If this wasn't you, ignore this email; nothing will change.

errors.nameTooLong: Use at most 80 characters for your name.
errors.affiliationTooLong: Use at most 120 characters for your affiliation.
errors.countryInvalid: Choose a country from the list.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts from your connection. Wait 15 minutes, then try again.
errors.altcha: The automatic check against spam did not work. Please try again.

sign.title: Sign the manifesto
sign.intro: Sign with your name and confirm with your email address. Only your name, affiliation and country are published; your email address is not.
sign.name: Name
sign.nameHint: As it should appear in the list of signatures.
sign.affiliationHint: For example your employer, university or project.
sign.emailHint: We send you a link to confirm. The address is not published.
sign.consent: I agree that my name, affiliation and country will be published on this site.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.text: We have sent you a link to confirm your signature. It is valid for 48 hours.
checkEmail.spam: Nothing there after a few minutes? Check your spam folder, or sign again.

confirm.title: Confirm your signature
confirm.intro: Check your details, then confirm. Your signature is published once you confirm.
confirm.usedText: Each confirmation link works once. If you confirmed, your signature is in the list.
confirm.invalid: This link is not valid or has expired.
confirm.invalidText: Confirmation links are valid for 48 hours. Sign again to get a new one.

thanks.title: Thank you for signing
thanks.text: Your signature is now in the list.
thanks.alreadyText: This email address was used to sign before, so your existing signature stays as it is.

signatures.title: Signatures
signatures.pageEmpty: There are no signatures on this page.

withdraw.title: Withdraw your signature
withdraw.intro: Enter the email address you signed with. If a signature exists for it, we send you a link to delete it. Your email address is not stored in readable form.
withdraw.paused: Withdrawing opens soon, together with signing.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.text: If a signature exists for this address, we sent a link to withdraw it. The link is valid for 48 hours.
checkEmail.spam: Nothing there after a few minutes? Check your spam folder, or try again.

confirm.title: Delete your signature
confirm.intro: This is the signature that will be deleted. It disappears from the list as soon as you confirm.
confirm.usedText: Each withdrawal link works once. If you used it, your signature is gone from the list.
confirm.invalid: This link is not valid or has expired.
confirm.invalidText: Withdrawal links are valid for 48 hours.
confirm.none: There is no signature for this address any more.
confirm.noneText: It may have been deleted already. Nothing is left to withdraw.

done.title: Your signature is deleted
done.text: It is no longer in the list of signatures. You can sign again at any time.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.text: An unexpected error occurred on our side. Please try again later.
